figurative_meaning_en: A reduplicative expression denoting intense brightness and luster
similar_in_english: All that glitters is not gold
example_sentences_in_bangla: সূর্যের আলোয় তার গহনা চকচক করছে।
যা চকচক করে তাই সোনা নয়, সাবধানে দেখো।
example_sentences_in_english: Her jewelry is sparkling in the sunlight.
All that glitters is not gold, so be careful.
history: Associated with the Bengali proverb 'যা চকচক করে তাই সোনা নয়', which originates from folk wisdom cautioning against superficial judgments, similar to English proverbs.
note: This idiom is often used in proverbial contexts to describe deceptive appearances.
